concept.interaction: Arrange the four board panels on a flat table, lower the inlays into their recesses, and place king, queen, bishop, knight, rook and pawn on their standard starting squares. Lift each chessman by its lower body to make orthodox chess moves. The familiar skyline remains a coherent city as positions change. Lift the loose board panels and inlays separately for storage.
concept.print_stance: Every part prints upright or flat with bed datum Z=0. Four board panels and 32 dark inlays are separate for bed size and contrasting squares. Recommended PLA at 0.20 mm layers, 3 walls, 20 percent infill; support may be used under knight muzzle and overhanging cornices. No electronics or purchased components.
risks: King tipping and slender crown sections require geometry measurement and physical printing before durability claims.
Cultural relief is a selective interpretation of each community and relies on an illustrated identification guide for historical explanation.
concept.signature_decision: A city skyline becomes an orthodox chess position: six distinct architecture-to-role translations stand above a single continuous neighborhood frieze. Both sides share all communities.
concept.summary: A complete New York chess set uniting landmark towers, rooftop water tanks and a sculpted route through five city communities. Warm limestone and midnight blue-green armies share an architectural language of stepped stone plinths and recessed detail.
concept.title: Civic Skyline

design_changes.reason: Remove the thin lip detected by fixed 0.4 mm nozzle wall checking while retaining the Flatiron plan and bishop cue.
design_changes.selected: Planar tapered mitre with a bounded diagonal recess and 4.2 mm rear web

design_changes.previous: Sharp diagonal pocket corners and lower queen arch tangent to a tier edge
design_changes.reason: Remove four-face mesh edge junctions. Preserve full square pitch, 0.25 mm straight-edge clearance and nested crown arches.
design_changes.selected: Matching 2 mm chamfers on pockets and inlays; lower crown arch starts above the tier

design_changes.change: Open pocket corners square where they meet panel boundaries while retaining internal 2 mm corner bridges; use concentric queen crown engravings at Z58, radii 7.2/4.6/2.0 with 1.3 mm lands.
design_changes.reason: Round r0001 identified thin seam wedges and converging offset crown-arch slivers. Repairs retain the 42 mm square grid, continuous 2.4 mm floor and Chrysler fan identity.

design_changes.previous: Short generic king setbacks, flat queen crown with concentric arc engravings, and a weakly articulated bishop wedge.
design_changes.reason: The first independent blind review recognized architectural chess but failed all three required landmark identities. This single coherent visual repair enlarges their specific architectural signatures while retaining heights, shared bases, opposing sides and orthodox rules.
design_changes.selected: Seven king tiers around a long shaft and stout mast; four solid Chrysler arch fans with triangular window recesses; a symmetric Flatiron wedge with facade grid and broad cornice, retaining the diagonal bishop cue.

design_changes.previous: Horizontal exterior shoulders, bishop recessed-band roofs, round knight eye pockets, and the steep pawn tank transition in the visually reviewed geometry.
design_changes.reason: The integrated CAD verifier failed the default 45-degree overhang check on all six chess roles. These geometry changes retain the six silhouettes and overall heights while removing every support-required region in fresh role STLs under the unchanged 45-degree and 12 mm bridge limits. Make round r0005 wall checks and six fresh overhang reports pass. The geometry change invalidates the prior visual review, which is preserved in review-history/pre-overhang-repair.
design_changes.selected: Sloped base and crown shoulders on king, queen, bishop and rook; a sloped king cross underside; a sloped knight pedestal with pointed diamond eye roofs; tapered bishop band roofs; and a longer pawn cone from radius 5.4 mm at Z17 to radius 8.5 mm at Z22.

design_changes.previous: Eight concept keys grouped the complete four-panel board as board and repeated meshes as inlays and six role names, while the verified delivery package uses 68 exact occurrence filenames. The Make finalizer reported missing parts/board.stl.
design_changes.reason: Correct the printable inventory contract to actual single-shell files and per-panel bed dimensions without adding duplicate print jobs or changing the reviewed design.
design_changes.selected: Eleven single-part geometry families identified by exact existing occurrence keys: four board panels plus representative tile_a1 and six ivory role occurrences. All 68 occurrence meshes, quantities, colors, geometry, renders and rules are unchanged. Panel board_0_0 anchors the signature flag for the shared four-panel civic border.
